notes.source: The top bar's notification control, in both clients (#659): what it is called, and what it is called when it has something to say. The site composed the second string inline in a template literal; the app draws the same control, so both read one source (ADR-0098) - a bell that cannot say how many are unread is a control that lies, and one that says it in different words on each client is two controls.
notes.placeholders: `{count}` is the unread count, which each client substitutes itself.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a key `frontend/ui/shared/notification-bell.tsx` does not render.
